A split scene showing Paul's two analogies. On the left side, a stern ancient Roman servant (the "schoolmaster") holding a rod, guiding a small boy who looks unhappy and burdened by heavy scrolls representing the Law. On the right side, the same boy is now a grown man, being warmly embraced by his wealthy father who is handing him a glowing document representing his inheritance and adoption, while a dove (the Holy Spirit) hovers above them.
